description: Find company accounts in a CRM list that are likely the same business entered twice. Send the company names (with your account codes if you like). Names are compared after removing legal-form endings (Inc, Incorporated, Corp, Co, LLC, Ltd, LLP, PLC, GmbH, S.A. and others listed in the rule), accents, punctuation, spaces, case, a leading 'The' and '&' versus 'and'. Get back the groups of accounts whose names match, each member's legal form, and a flag where the legal forms differ (Acme Inc and Acme LLC may be two companies). Company names only: a name that starts with a personal title (Mr, Dr ...) and has no legal ending is refused; other personal names cannot all be detected, so send company accounts only. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/account-name-dedupe). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

account.description: Optional: your account or record code, echoed back.

name.description: Company name as stored, e.g. 'Acme, Inc.'. Not a person's name. A name with a web-address ending (Example.com) is refused: send it without the ending.

label.description: Optional label for the list (your own text, echoed).

name: account_name_dedupe
title: Company Account Name Duplicate Check
